crewNotes.text: General Taiwan traveller allowances; crew should confirm any crew-specific treatment with the Customs Administration. Compiled from the cited guidance, pending final authority review.

rules.text: Passengers aged 18 or over may bring in 1.5 litres of alcoholic beverages (no limit on the number of bottles).
Foreign currency exceeding the equivalent of USD 10,000 must be declared to Customs.

declarationRequirements.text: Personal or household articles (excluding controlled goods, cigarettes and alcohol) up to a total value of NTD 35,000 are exempt; above that, goods must be declared.

rules.text: Passengers may bring in 200 cigarettes, or 25 cigars, or 1 pound of tobacco.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.

sources.pageTitle: Duty-exempted goods and maximum quantities for arriving passengers
